363	        borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusMd)),
364	        boxShadow: DesignTokens.elevation1,
365	      ),
366	      child: child,
367	    );
368	  }

## Spec Change Log
input.new_string:
- Given `totalCount` is `0` or `1`, when the screen renders, then no narrative text, error, or retry ever appears, regardless of the narrative fetch's own result.

### Review Findings

- [ ] [Review][Patch] Gated narrative-error VoiceOver announcement can be permanently missed for the whole screen-open when the narrative fetch errors *before* the aggregate fetch resolves to `totalCount > 30` — the amendment's gate is read once, at the narrative cubit's own error transition, and never re-checked once the aggregate later resolves, so the error becomes visible on screen with no announcement ever having fired [account_settings_screen.dart:231-247]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `_narrativeSection(BuildContext context)`'s own `context` parameter is dead — the inner `BlocBuilder`/`GestureDetector.onTap` already use their own shadowed context, so the `BuildContext` threading the Code Map called for was unnecessary [dashboard_chart_section.dart:249]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] "tentar novamente" retry link's tap target is no larger than its 13px text glyphs — no padding/minimum-size wrapper — despite this commit's own accessibility pass adding a `Semantics(button: true, ...)` role to the same link without addressing touch-target size [dashboard_chart_section.dart:285-298]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `heightFraction`'s `.clamp(0, 1)` guard (stops a negative malformed-backend bucket count from crashing the `Container`) has no test — a regression removing it would pass every existing test [dashboard_chart_section.dart:218]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] The `maxCount == 0` defensive guard's own target case (a non-empty, all-zero `bucketCounts` from `_condense`) is untested — a regression reverting it to `barCounts.isEmpty` would pass every existing test [dashboard_chart_section.dart:184-187]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] Blank/whitespace-only narrative string rendering nothing (vs. an empty `Text`) has no test — a regression dropping the `text.trim().isEmpty` check would pass every existing narrative test [dashboard_chart_section.dart:261-262]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] No semantics-tree assertion proves the retry link's `Semantics(button: true, ...)` role — the only existing retry test taps via `find.text()`, so dropping the `Semantics` wrapper would pass every existing test [dashboard_chart_section.dart:285-293]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] Loading-state `CircularProgressIndicator`'s new `semanticsLabel` ("Carregando gráfico de evolução") has no test asserting the label itself, only `findsOneWidget` [dashboard_chart_section.dart:94]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `DashboardNarrativeCubit.load()`'s `isClosed` half of its stale-call guard is untested — the sibling `DashboardCubit` has a dedicated "close() while load() in flight never throws" test, no equivalent exists here [dashboard_narrative_cubit_test.dart]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] New e2e `DashboardNarrativeCubit` group omits the retryable-`NETWORK_TIMEOUT`-exhausts-`RetryInterceptor` case the sibling `DashboardCubit` e2e group covers for the identical transport pipeline [dashboard_flow_e2e_test.dart]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] No e2e test proves `DashboardNarrativeCubit`'s `confirmedWrites` subscription reacts to the real, DI-wired `PendingEntryWriteTracker` singleton — only a hand-written-fake unit test exercises this, unlike `DashboardCubit`'s own dedicated e2e proof [dashboard_flow_e2e_test.dart]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `test-summary.md`'s edit states "+24 difference from the prior 1175/1175 baseline" immediately after removing a line that put the prior total at 1135/1135 — a 40-test gap nothing in this diff reconciles [tests/test-summary.md]
- [x] [Review][Defer] `DashboardNarrativeCubit`'s `confirmedWrites.listen((_) => load())` has no `onError` handler [dashboard_narrative_cubit.dart:24] — deferred, pre-existing: mirrors `DashboardCubit`'s identical, already-shipped pattern (frozen spec: "mirroring DashboardCubit's exact shape"), not a new defect introduced here.

## Spec Change Log

- **Finding (blind-hunter + verification-gap review, confirmed):** the original frozen Boundaries line ("announces a narrative `ResourceError` via its existing `_announce`, same as the chart's own error announcement") was unconditional — `narrativeCubit.load()` fires on every screen open regardless of count, so a `0`/`1`/mid-range-count user (for whom `DashboardChartSection` never renders the narrative section at all) could still hear a spoken "narrative failed" announcement for a UI element never shown to them. This also sits in tension with the adjacent frozen `Never: show narrative text or its error for 0/1-count states` line — an audio announcement is a form of showing that error. A second, smaller defect rode along: the announcement used the raw, unsanitized `Failure.message` while the on-screen narrative-unavailable text is fixed copy, so VoiceOver and sighted users received different wording for the same failure.

content.text:
**Code review complete.** 0 `decision-needed`, 12 `patch`, 1 `defer`, 6 dismissed as noise.

Findings written to the review findings section in `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-2-independent-narrative-text-narrative-unavailable-state.md`.

**Destaque principal (patch, severidade alta):** o anúncio VoiceOver do erro de narrativa — que esta story já tinha corrigido numa rodada de review anterior (Spec Change Log) — ainda pode ser silenciosamente perdido: a condição é avaliada só no instante em que `DashboardNarrativeCubit` emite erro; se isso acontece antes do `DashboardCubit` resolver para `totalCount > 30` (as duas chamadas correm em paralelo, sem ordem garantida), o erro acaba aparecendo na tela sem nunca ter sido anunciado. Três camadas de review (blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, acceptance-auditor) chegaram a essa mesma conclusão de forma independente.

Outros patches cobrem: tap-target pequeno no link "tentar novamente", um parâmetro `BuildContext` morto, e sete lacunas de teste (incluindo duas de severidade média — guardas defensivas contra crash de `heightFraction`/`maxCount==0` sem nenhum teste de regressão) mais uma inconsistência numérica em `test-summary.md`.

Descartados como ruído: o layout em duas linhas do erro+retry (confirmei contra o `cerne-prototype.html` — a marcação original já usa `flex-direction:column`, então a implementação está correta), a cobertura indireta do DTO de narrativa (mesma convenção já usada no DTO irmão), e dois itens já documentados/aceitos no próprio `deferred-work.md` ou nas Design Notes da spec.
